rounds.title: Round 0: roster, three rounds, checks
rounds.summary: Sim reworked into three seeded rounds over a fixed roster. Show script, fake show, channel and tests written.

rounds.title: Round 1: the stage, first critics
rounds.summary: Feed-driven stage, new race display and show cards, cut-line director, synthesised sound.
rounds.critic: Readability 5, 5, 6; looks 6, 7, 6; camera 4, 3, 4. The camera is not on what the graphics talk about; no single lock moment.

rounds.title: Round 2: follow the line to the line
rounds.summary: Title call opens the line-up, a lock beat, finish-line camera, tags only on visible Gumbles.
rounds.critic: Readability 5, 5, 6; looks 6; camera 4, 4, 3. Ticker contradicts the tower, the final is a runaway, the lock is too quiet.

rounds.title: Round 3: the lock, the lens, a closer final
rounds.summary: Full-width lock card, per-round camera set-ups, final tightened in the sim, incidents-only event line.
rounds.critic: Readability 6, 6, 5; looks 6, 6, 5; camera 4.5, 4, 3. Tags float over the wrong creature; the open window has no state.

rounds.title: Round 4: stay with the same Gumbles
rounds.summary: Sticky home shot, side-on final, clock to the lock, one winner card, tags that point at heads.
rounds.critic: Readability 7, 6, 6; looks 7, 6, 6; camera 6, 4, 3. Hidden places in the tower; the pick loses its place off camera.

rounds.title: Round 5: the open bar, the chase
rounds.summary: White open bar that swells into the lock band, finish camera only for the last-place fight, leader and chase alternate in a runaway final.
rounds.critic: Readability 7, 7, 7; looks 6; camera 4, 3, 4; phases 7, betting rhythm 7.

rounds.title: Round 6: formal tests
rounds.summary: Comprehension 4 of 5, 5 of 5, 5 of 5. Blind look test 21 of 24. A whole show at real window lengths: 4:18, no errors, 60 fps.

rounds.title: Round 7: longer rounds, the camera on video, dead air, sound
rounds.summary: Rounds One and Two lengthened. Race camera rebuilt as one tracking shot with see-through maze blocks and one cut to a line camera; judged on 4 fps strips over seven versions. Dead air, idle, mid-show join and sound measured and fixed.
rounds.critic: Camera alone 3 to 4 throughout; in blind picks the Director won 3 of 3 and the final's cut 3 of 3. Sound by measurement 4, 6, 6, 7. Comprehension 15 of 15.

rounds.title: Round 8: the owner watched it
rounds.summary: Stage text cut hard, twice. unlockAudio() added. Sound now recorded: one looping CC0 track and thirteen CC0 one-shots, with synthesised stand-ins as fallback.
rounds.critic: Text audit "nearly", then its list was cut. Comprehension 15 of 15. Recorded sound by measurement 5, then 6 of 10. Nobody has listened to it yet.
